handover_checklist.description: Checklist for QA team when picking up a module to test
steps: 1. Read the module entry in this qa-tracker.json
2. Check known_issues — some are expected, don't re-report
3. Run existing unit tests: npx vitest run <test-file>
4. Test API endpoints with curl/Postman using Aurora org credentials
6. Verify data flows: create record → check linked modules updated
7. Check Ed can invoke the module's skills via /api/skills/invoke
8. Report: what works, what's broken, what's missing vs spec
9. Update this file with test results
